column: Advanced Practice Provider - Advanced Lung Disease- Pulmonary HTN

detail.description:
The Advanced Practice Provider (APP) provides medical services to individuals, families and groups, emphasizing
health promotion and disease prevention. This includes the assessment, diagnosis and management of acute and
chronic diseases. Responsible for performing job duties in accordance with mission, vision and values of Tampa General Hospital.

Job Description:

Provides specialized longitudinal care for patients with pulmonary hypertension and CTEPH, including diagnostic evaluation, management and monitoring of PH-directed therapies, patient education, and multidisciplinary care coordination. The position is currently clinic-based but is designed to evolve with program growth to support an admitting inpatient PH/CTEPH service. The APP will provide continuity across ambulatory and inpatient settings while supporting expansion of the CTEPH program, development of standardized clinical pathways, and management of an increasingly complex pulmonary vascular patient population.

  • Advanced Practice Registered Nurse with 3 years related experience
  • Acute Care Certification
  • Physician Assistant

column: Advanced Practice Provider - Advanced Lung Disease- COPD

detail.description:
The Advanced Practice Provider (APP) provides medical services to individuals, families and groups, emphasizing
health promotion and disease prevention. This includes the assessment, diagnosis and management of acute and
chronic diseases. Responsible for performing job duties in accordance with mission, vision and values of TampaGeneral Hospital.

Job Description:

Provides longitudinal outpatient management of patients with COPD, including new and follow-up visits, post-hospital care, medication and inhaler optimization, oxygen management, review of diagnostic testing, patient education, and coordination with pulmonary rehabilitation and other services. The role is designed to improve access to pulmonary care, optimize COPD management, identify clinical deterioration early, and reduce preventable exacerbations, ED utilization, and hospital readmissions.

Advanced Practice Registered Nurse Or Physician Assistant
